answer: Sequential work at join. Each new key must compute a verifiable delay function, 2^32 squarings in a class group seeded by its own address, about 6 hours on one fast core, and it must redo a fresh one every 30 days. Checking a proof takes under 1 s. A farm of 1,000 sybils needs 6,000 core hours a month, a ridge of real cost that no marble-smooth script can skip. Rewards stay at 10% until a key has 3 renewals behind it, so a farm sits on a cold tundra of tiny payouts for 90 days before it earns full share.
